explanation: Team 'security-team' scoped constraint 'allowed-image-repos' to ['team-security']. Namespaces ['team-backend', 'team-data'] carry the same class label but have no equivalent constraint. Review whether the gap is intended.

Team 'backend-team' granted RBAC access (role 'trigger-data-jobs') in namespace 'team-data' to 'team-backend/backend-app-sa'. Team 'data-team' applies default-deny ingress ('default-deny-ingress') in the same namespace. RBAC governs Kubernetes API calls and NetworkPolicy governs pod traffic, so this is not a direct contradiction. If the subject also needs network access to pods in 'team-data', the policy may block it. Review.
